finder.about: Shared vectors for the server finder. tests\ParityTests.cs checks them against src\Launcher\ServerFinder.cs; the SteamOS finder must give the same answers.

beacon.about: UDP only. The finder never opens a TCP connection to the game port (the dedicated server dies on any connection without a valid handshake). A client sends the request as one datagram to host:beaconPort and accepts only a reply that is exactly replyPrefix + a decimal port 1..65535 (ASCII, no spaces or newline around it); the Found server's port is the one in the reply, not the candidate's. Each distinct candidate host is pinged once. The responder runs only in a hosting launcher while its dedicated server runs, binds IPv4 any:beaconPort, answers only the exact request and ignores everything else.
